original_text: <!-- (Audio) Maria: On Fridays, I like to hang out with friends. We normally meet at a bar, chat, and have something to eat and drink. But I'm not really a night owl, so I like to be back home by 9:30 tops. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Maria: Po petkom volim da se družim sa prijateljima. Obično se sastajemo u baru, pričamo i nešto pojemo i popijemo. Ali ja nisam baš noćna ptica, pa volim da budem kod kuće do 21:30 najkasnije. -->
